description: The Bramblehorn Doe is a majestic woodland creature with antlers resembling tangled vines and leaves. Its fur shimmers with a faint, greenish hue, blending seamlessly with the forest environment. Known for its gentle nature and its ability to heal the land, it serves as a protector of the forest, calling upon the flora to entangle foes and shield allies. Its large, soft eyes convey wisdom and a deep connection to nature.

traits.name: Forest Camouflage
traits.description: The Bramblehorn Doe has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

traits.name: Entangling Vines
traits.description: Once per short rest, the Bramblehorn Doe can summon vines to entangle a 20-foot square area within 30 feet. Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained. The vines last for 1 minute or until the Bramblehorn Doe dismisses them.

traits.name: Nature's Grace
traits.description: The Bramblehorn Doe regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in a forest or surrounded by natural plant life.

actions.name: Hoof Attack
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Healing Aura
actions.description: Once per day, the Bramblehorn Doe can create a healing aura within a 10-foot radius. Any friendly creatures within the aura regain 2d8 hit points.
